flags.reason: The guide (checked 8 October on 0.1.78-636f3f5) says in Anatomy “It has no surface or padding of its own”, but the installed ValueBackMetric.tsx (0.1.78-dbe0e02, read from source) paints valueBackMetric/background/color, white in Light and Dark; and on dbe0e02 its In context Card defaults to AppearanceBrand Neutral, so the header icons there are grey, not gold. The entry follows the package and does not repeat “no surface”. Guide fix #525. Added by Claude Code in the overnight run agentpack-batch7, for Marcin to confirm.

examples.purpose: Rewards on the home screen, the guide's In context: one programme per card, side by side, with a distinct verb on each (Earn, View); the screen opens the programme when a call to action is pressed (onLinkPress).
examples.jsx:
<Card>
  <VStack>
    <Text>Your rewards</Text>
    <HStack justifyHorizontal="space-around" wrap>
      <ValueBackMetric
        title="JioPoints"
        value="1,240"
        caption="Earn 10 points with UPI"
        linkLabel="Earn"
        onLinkPress={() => {}}
      />
      <ValueBackMetric
        title="Cashback"
        value="₹120"
        caption="Credited monthly"
        linkLabel="View"
        onLinkPress={() => {}}
      />
    </HStack>
  </VStack>
</Card>

from.quote: Place one programme per card, side by side, with a distinct verb on each. The screen opens the programme when a call to action is pressed.

props.name: icon
props.description: Header glyph slot, shown to the left of the title. Mirrors the Figma swap slot whose preferred instances are `Icon` and `Image`: - a registry icon name (e.g. `'ic_rupee_coin'`) renders the shared {@link Icon}, colour/size from the `icon/*` tokens (default 18px gold — retint via `modes`, e.g. `{ AppearanceBrand: 'Secondary' }`); - a custom node (an `<Icon/>`, an `<Image/>`, your brand logo) renders as-is with `modes` cascaded into it. The Figma design uses a dedicated JioPoints brand mark that is not in the icon registry, so `ic_rupee_coin` stands in by default. Default "ic_rupee_coin", from the component source.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title next to the icon. Defaults to `'JioPoints'`. Default "JioPoints", from the component source.

props.name: value
props.description: The prominent value line (16px/500). Pass a string, or any node to compose a richer value. Hidden when omitted.

props.name: caption
props.description: In a 120 px column the caption wraps and nothing overflows. Declared: Muted caption below the value (12px, `#777`). Hidden when omitted.

props.name: linkLabel
props.description: Bottom CTA label rendered as the shared {@link Text} (purple 12px via seeded `Text Appearance: Secondary` + `Text Sizes: Small`). Hidden when omitted. Ignored when the {@link link} slot is provided.

props.name: link
props.description: Real slot for the bottom CTA. Highest precedence — when provided, these children render instead of the declarative `linkLabel` Text. Seeded `Text Appearance: Secondary` + `Text Sizes: Small` cascade into the slot (so a bare `<Text text="Earn" />` matches the design); child-level modes still win.

props.name: onLinkPress
props.description: Fired when the declarative CTA (`linkLabel`) is pressed.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`). Independent of {@link onLinkPress} — the bottom CTA keeps its own handler.

props.name: modes
props.description: Design-token modes for theming. Cascaded to slot children.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label. Defaults to the resolved `title`, `value`, `caption` and `linkLabel` joined together.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: A token collection ValueBackMetric reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

events.name: onLinkPress
events.description: On the web, Enter and Space on the call to action call onLinkPress, as a click does (#184, fixed on 636f3f5). Declared: Fired when the declarative CTA (`linkLabel`) is pressed.

events.name: onPress
events.description: With onPress the card is a button and the call to action is a sibling link beside it, not inside it; each click calls only its own handler. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable (rendered through a `Pressable` with `accessibilityRole="button"`). Independent of {@link onLinkPress} — the bottom CTA keeps its own handler.
